hypothesis: The hard target30 switch at compound sweep6 causes avoidable braking even when the recognized obstacle is distant and curvature is only moderately above the compound threshold. A continuous distance-and-severity target capped at36 should carry more speed through that bounded entry regime while restoring target30 before close or extreme geometry and immediately on detector miss.

scope.single_factor: Replace the hard target30 only on current-visible far moderate compound frames with a bounded continuous target derived from existing obstacle row and road sweep.

requirements: a current detector-recognized obstacle is present
the inherited compound latch target is exactly30
obstacle center row y is below44
image-space sweep is at least6 and below12

brake_consistency.requirement: A raised compound target must retain the current softened compound brake envelope clip(0.04+0.012*excess,0.04,0.18) with inherited base brake as floor; falling back to the generic0.06+0.018 envelope could paradoxically increase braking.
brake_consistency.implementation_constraint: Extend the existing compound-carry predicate only to reachable current-visible adaptive targets. Preserve the exact existing predicate for target30 and every nonadaptive state.

latch_safety.rule: Keep _pace_latched_target at30 even while the current visible command target is raised. The first detector miss therefore immediately returns command target to30.
latch_safety.reason: A detector miss can be flicker or an oversized close component, not proof the obstacle is behind the vehicle.

frozen: near current obstacles y>=44 at target30
extreme current compound sweep>=12 at target30
all detector-miss latch frames1--4 at target30 and the existing base-only brake release
all obstacle detection, steering, obstacle-side state, latch duration and recovery
the compound brake formula itself and the inherited base brake/final float32 clamp
model.pt and every non-bare inference route
official environment, reward, termination, frame skip and action contract
static_acceptance: The exact target table, monotonic distance/severity behavior and boundaries immediately around y32/y44 and sweep6/sweep12 match the registered formula and remain within30--36.
Only current-visible frames satisfying y<44 and6<=sweep<12 may differ; steering and shared inherited state other than _pace_command_target remain exact.
The existing softened compound brake envelope is used for every adaptive target, with finite bounded actions and no gas/brake overlap.
Near, extreme, noncompound, obstacle-free, straight, strong-steer, fifth-clear, invalid-input, road-loss and reset behavior remain control-exact.
After any raised current command, detector miss1 immediately returns target30; miss1--4, fifth clear, sixth release and reacquisition at every miss phase match their registered control semantics.
Far-to-near progression, increasing severity and alternating detector flicker never preserve an uplift outside the current qualifying frame.
Both turn directions and obstacle sides receive symmetric coverage.
Randomized sequence differential coverage proves every action/target difference is eligible and all outputs/states remain finite and bounded.
Affected controller, inference, local-contract and submission suites pass.
An isolated package passes exact-file import, reset, finite-action, bounds and latency smoke without modifying root submission.zip.
rollback: Any target above36 or below the control target, or any uplift at y>=44, sweep<6, sweep>=12, detector miss or no-current-obstacle state.
Any steering, detector, obstacle-side, latch-duration, reset, invalid-input, recovery, dependency, packaging, bounds, NaN or latency regression.
Any use of the generic stronger curve-brake envelope on an adaptive target.

future_environment_gate.reason: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf are absent.
future_environment_gate.design_after_restoration: Freeze paired control and candidate package hashes and evaluate fresh gentle, moderate-compound and extreme-hairpin obstacle seeds. Rank valid finish first, then progress/collision/crash/off-track/minimum clearance and only then paired lap/sector time.
future_environment_gate.safety_rollback: Reject on any new DNF, lower finish count, added collision/crash/off-track, materially lower minimum clearance or operational failure.
future_environment_gate.pace_gate: Only after safety non-regression, require lower paired compound-entry sector and lap time.

evidence_limits: Submission videos cannot reconstruct internal sweep/row timing or prove which encounters qualify.
Raising target changes both braking and gas branches and therefore future observations even when same-input steering is exact.
The maximum36, row44 and sweep12 safeguards are conservative engineering choices, not validated physical-optimum thresholds.
No environment cell, training run, official submission or SOTA comparison is authorized by this protocol.
